springSecurity.checkMatchers.title: Warn about request matchers placed after anyRequest() and narrower matchers shadowed by an earlier broader one

springSecurity.checkPathPatterns.title: Warn about a ** before the last segment of request matcher path patterns (rejected by PathPatternParser)

springSecurity.checkDebug.title: Warn when security debug logging is enabled (@EnableWebSecurity(debug = true), WebSecurity.debug(true), <debug/>)

springSecurity.checkBeanReferences.title: Report bean references (userDetailsServiceBeanName, @bean in security expressions, ref attributes of the security namespace) that no bean of the project answers (Info)

springSecurity.checkSelfInvocation.title: Warn when a method protected by @PreAuthorize, @PostAuthorize, @PreFilter or @PostFilter is called from the same class (skips the proxy; wrong when method security uses AspectJ mode)
